picks.reasoning: CFO's carries just have better hands than TLAW's lineup, and in a best of 1 better players beat a decent team setup. I don't care what the LTA crowd is hyping, TLAW loses the lane matchups and loses the game.

CFO play at a breakneck pace: they hit early skirmishes, take first drakes and invade, and in a best of one that early snowball usually beats TLAW's slower, scaling style. If TLAW can't match CFO's jungle tempo before 15 minutes, the map is gone.

CFO's mid-jungle duo has the deeper, more aggressive champion pool, and in a Bo1 the team with more comfort picks to draft around gets the edge. TLAW will have to draft well to cover their weaker solo lanes, and I don't see them pulling that off this time.
CFO's recent international record and series results are better than TLAW's, but in a best of 1 the gap isn't big enough to lean hard. I'm taking a modest edge, not a confident call.

CFO play like a group that trusts each other: they're loose, they fight together, and they show up hungry on the big stage. In a single game, that confidence can beat a TLAW side that still seems to be working out its rhythm.
